name: merman-web-workspace
description: Build workspace for the lockstep @mermanjs/browser package group.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts && npm run build:packages
scripts.build:ts: npm run build:entries && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && npm run check:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.smoke: npm run verify:wasm-inputs && npm run verify:packages && node scripts/smoke.mjs && npm run smoke:dom-safety:built
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('The Web workspace is private; publish an admitted package-group artifact instead.')"
